records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At September 30, 2024, our dollar-based net revenue retention rate marginally increased from the quarter ended June 30, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •$18.9 million decrease in deferred revenue was primarily driven by timing of billings for subscription and support;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At September 30, 2024, we had 397,095 individual users across 4,433 customers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: •$2.9 million increase in computer software expenses due to higher spend on cloud hosting services as customers continue to migrate to the Google Cloud Platform, as well as an increase in software purchases;

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the nine months ended September 30, 2024, cash provided by operations was $147.0 million, resulting from net income of $104.3 million, net non-cash expenses of approximately $26.1 million, and net cash flows provided as a result of changes in operating assets and liabilities of $16.7 million.
